title: Responsiveness of Outcome Measures in Chronic Non-Specific Low Back Pain: A Secondary Analysis of a Randomized Controlled Trial
time_scope: T0 to T1, after the 2-week intervention.
excluded: T0–T2, Bournemouth, EQ-5D, AUC/ROC and anchor correlations
Responder classification and arm-specific treatment-effect estimates
population_or_material: The pooled analysis cohort reported for the T0–T1 responsiveness estimates in this secondary analysis.
requested_items: Table 2 T0–T1 mean change/SD and SMD/CI for NRS/ODI/RMDQ only. Do not recalculate SMD or infer its sign convention from the mean change. Exclude AUC and later T2 follow-up.
case_specific_rules: Raw mean changes and reported SMDs are different principal statistics. Preserve each reported sign independently; do not reverse an SMD to match a raw change or reconstruct an unspecified standardization/sign convention.
